thread:
Alicia (CS): Quick flag 1: multiple onboarding customers reported degraded search results after indexing (noticed 05:05 UTC). Engineering investigating. Need a short customer status + remediation offer.

Dev - CS Ops: Can we classify impact? Suggest: blocker (no search), degraded (missing top results), cosmetic.

Alicia (CS): Blocker: acct-lynx, acct-orchid. Degraded: ~9 trials. I'll export list to #cs-ops-docs.

Maya (Support): Proposed remediation: priority reindex for blockers + 2-week onboarding extension and 10% onboarding credit. For degraded: expedited re-rank + 1-week extension. Offer 1:1 enablement call.

Rafi (SRE): Root cause quick summary: embedding pipeline used an old tokenizer variant during a recent deploy, producing mismatched vectors for some docs. Patch deployed at 05:20 UTC; backfill started. ETA ~2-5 hours depending on queue. We'll provide progress updates.

Noah (Product): If any account is flagged as renewal-risk, let's offer a dedicated success lead + AM escalation and consider a tailored credits package. Also propose a temporary search-algorithm fallback for worst impacted tenants (48h). Need infra + billing signoff.

Alicia (CS): Draft status for review: "We discovered an internal issue that caused some recently indexed documents to have lower search relevance. Engineering deployed a fix and we are reprocessing affected items. We'll prioritize accounts most impacted and follow up with an estimated completion time. Your success lead will contact you to schedule any needed enablement and discuss credits."

Dev - CS Ops: Add renewal-risk language: "If this interferes with your contractual go-live, we will escalate and work with you directly on remediation and compensation options."

Rafi (SRE): FAQ blurb for customers: "Cause: tokenizer mismatch during embedding generation introduced vector drift for a subset of documents. Fix: reverted to correct tokenizer, re-generated vectors, and launched backfills. Preventive steps: deploy-time tokenizer validation and an alert on vector-distribution drift."

Maya (Support): Action: I need CSV with columns account, severity (blocker/degraded), owner, contact-email, MRR. Can we have it by 11:30am PT so I can run segmented sends?

Alicia (CS): Uploaded CSV to #cs-ops-docs. @Noah confirm billing credit thresholds? @Rafi please update ETA when you have progress.

Noah (Product): Billing ok to pre-approve up to 15% credit for accounts <$4k MRR; require AM approval above. Fallback requires infra tagging.

Rafi (SRE): Progress 06:00 UTC: 35% processed, verification checks passing on processed batches. New ETA ~3h for current queue. Posting updates every 30m.

Dev - CS Ops: I'll draft two email templates (blocker + degraded) and share in #cs-review in 10m.

NotifyBot: Templates uploaded (link). Requesting signoff from @Alicia, @Noah, @Rafi.

Alicia (CS): We'll include a 2-question pulse after the email: 1) Did this block your go-live? 2) Would you like a live enablement session? Capturing responses in the renewal tracker.

Maya (Support): I'll wire the survey automation and tag replies. Standing by to escalate urgent replies to on-call.

Rafi (SRE): Postmortem ETA: EOD tomorrow. We'll include timeline, root cause, and actions (tokenizer validation, deploy guard, monitoring).

Alicia (CS): Reminder: cc billing@redwood.com on credit approvals and loop AMs for >$4k MRR accounts. Will post final send time and recipient list once templates are signed off.

Dev - CS Ops: Noted. Scheduling follow-ups and enablement slots for blockers.

Maya (Support): Ready to monitor replies.

Rafi (SRE): Updating channel in 30m with new progress metrics.

Alicia (CS): Thanks team 1 executing plan."
